extracted.intended_audience: media professionals, journalists, advertisers, photographers/videographers, and website operators seeking to cover or use Goodwill of North Georgia branding or facilities
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for journalists, media outlets, advertisers, and photographers on coordinating interviews, using Goodwill of North Georgia branding, and filming/photographing on Goodwill premises. Covers approval, asset requests, and on-site procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Marketing Department as first point of reference
rubrics_metrics.description: We urge you to contact us as the first point of reference for any marketing assignment that involves Goodwill of North Georgia. We understand that in a 24-hour news cycle, time is often a luxury you may not have, so when deadlines are tight, contact us as soon as possible and we will work to get you the information, resources and interviews you need.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always contact the Marketing Department before beginning a project that involves Goodwill of North Georgia so they can provide accurate, authoritative information and resources. Early contact helps expedite requests under tight deadlines and allows staff to coordinate interviews, images, or other elements needed for the story or project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate and route all interviews through the marketing team
rubrics_metrics.description: In an effort to give you the most authoritative and accurate information possible, we ask that you coordinate all interviews regarding Goodwill activities or program participants with our marketing team. Even if you already have direct contact information for interview subjects, contacting our department first will allow us to provide faster service, background information and additional elements for your stories and projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely solely on direct contact with program participants or staff for interviews; route interview requests through Marketing so they can arrange appropriate spokespeople, ensure accuracy, perform fact-checking, provide quotes, and supply supporting images/graphics. This minimizes misinformation and protects participant privacy/sensitivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing staff availability for interviews, fact-checking, quotes, and assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Our marketing staff is available for interviews, fact checking, quotes and to provide images and graphics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When needing official statements, verification of facts, or branded imagery, request support from Marketing. Use their materials and quotes to maintain consistency with Goodwill’s messaging and to access approved visuals rather than sourcing unofficial materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request logo usage rights and follow brand guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome the opportunity for inclusion in your advertising and on your website. In order to protect our brand identity and to ensure our logo is used correctly, we ask that you request logo usage rights from our Marketing Team. The Marketing Team will provide you with the needed assets, brand guidelines and approval to use the Goodwill of North Georgia branding elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before using any Goodwill of North Georgia logos or branded elements in advertising, websites, or promotional materials, request permission and obtain the official assets and brand guidance from Marketing. Do not use unofficial, altered, or unapproved logos. Follow provided brand guidelines and obtain explicit approval for intended uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: "I support Goodwill" materials availability
rubrics_metrics.description: We also have “I support Goodwill” materials that are available upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want to include supportive messaging rather than official branding, ask Marketing about the available ‘I support Goodwill’ materials and the proper way to use them; request and use only approved collateral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photography/video permission and privacy protections
rubrics_metrics.description: In order to protect the privacy and appropriate sensitivity of our donors, customers, employees and program participants, in all cases, photographers/videographers must receive permission from our department before taking pictures or shooting video in our facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Never photograph or film on-site without prior written or explicit permission from Marketing. Permission is required for all shoots to ensure privacy, consent, and sensitivity of donors, customers, employees, and program participants. Unauthorized photography/filming may be denied or halted.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-site media presence and coordination during photo/video shoots
rubrics_metrics.description: In most cases, a media representative will also need to be present during the photo/video shoot. We can help you determine where to set up to achieve the best shots and make necessary arrangements with managers and staff on site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect a Goodwill representative to accompany media during shoots; coordinate with Marketing to select locations, schedule access, and arrange for managers/staff to be available. Use Marketing’s guidance to achieve appropriate shots while respecting operational needs and participant privacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided Marketing contact information for requests and approvals
rubrics_metrics.description: Marketing Department Contacts: Trenise Lyons, Director of Communications & Customer Engagement 678.701.0590 Office 770.609.5628 Cell tlyons@ging.org
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All requests for interviews, logos, photography/video permission, and other media-related needs should be directed to the listed Marketing contact to secure approvals, assets, and logistical coordination.
